messages:
Nina Park: Heads-up — Orbit Retail flagged a cross-silo adoption request. They want to enable 3 new teams (Merch, Customer Insights, Ops) to start using embeddings + chat flows next month.
Jonas Reed: Nice. Do we have an expected timeline or pilot scope?
Nina Park: Pilot starts 2026-04-05. Merch wants real-time personalization, Insights wants nightly batch embeddings, Ops wants alerting + summaries.
Aseem Patel: Sounds like mixed workload: low-latency chat + high-throughput batch embed. Need to size throughput and caching. Any QPS / token estimates?
Nina Park: From Orbit: Merch peak ~120 rps generating ~60 tokens avg per request during peaks (campaigns). Insights batch ~500k docs nightly (embedding ops). Ops small qps but high retention of KV for summaries. They also asked about private deployment for PHI-sensitive logs.
Marta Kline: Platform note — 120 rps with 60 tokens avg -> rough peak tokens/s = 7200 tokens/s. With continuous batching we can handle, but autoscaling policies must be tuned. Also pre-warming KV caches for chat will help latency.
Jonas Reed: Renewal is healthy, they sign in July. Expansion would be upsell. Action: we should propose a Dedicated pilot + Private for Ops?
Aseem Patel: Recommend a two-track: 1) Hosted + Dedicated burst for Merch/Insights (we can route by policy), 2) Private VPC eval for Ops if they require data isolation. We should suggest model variants: smaller quantized model for batch embeddings, larger for Merch personalization.
Nina Park: Can SE team own the config + run a smoke test w/ sample dataset? Orbit can provide a 10k doc subset this week.
Aseem Patel: Yes — schedule sandbox access. I'll prep a sample rollout plan and an autoscale policy suggestion.
Marta Kline: For infra: I'll add a prewarm job and KV cache TTL guidance. Also want to flag burst capacity limits during campaign windows. If they need consistent latency we should reserve capacity (Dedicated).
Jonas Reed: Pricing ask inbound — Orbit wants an estimate for monthly incremental spend if they go full cross-silo. Any quick ballpark?
Marta Kline: Ballpark: with Dedicated reserved baseline to cover 120 rps peaks and nightly embed runs, estimate incremental $15k-$30k/mo depending on model family and compression. Will refine after we know model sizes.
Nina Park: I'll capture this in the account playbook and update renewal deck. Also need enablement materials per team: Merch (prompt templates + streaming guide), Insights (batch embed patterns), Ops (audit + KMS docs).
Aseem Patel: I'll draft enablement snippets. Example routing policy snippet for canary + fallback:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - match: route == "merch/*"
    priority: high
    pool: dedicated-merch
    fallback: hosted-small
```
Jonas Reed: Perfect. Can you also provide an eval suite for quality regression (merch personalization) so customer managers can sign off?
Aseem Patel: Will include a small eval harness + prompt set.
Nina Park: Next steps: 1) SE sandbox + smoke test (Aseem) 2) Infra prewarm + estimate (Marta) 3) Draft upsell + renewal update (Jonas/Nina).
Jonas Reed: I'll coordinate finance for provisional pricing.
alerts-bot: Reminder: create onboarding checklist card in CS Ops board for Orbit Retail — due 2026-03-30.
Nina Park: tagging timeline — can we have preliminary numbers by 03/24?
Marta Kline: Yes, I'll have an infra cost + capacity note by 03/22.
Aseem Patel: SE sandbox ready by 03/20, will need Orbit's 10k sample.
Jonas Reed: I'll ask Orbit to share sample and sign NDA for private eval.
Nina Park: Thanks team — low renewal risk but high expansion opportunity. Will update CRM and loop in legal for NDA. :thumbsup:
Aseem Patel: Quick note: watch for token spikes from Merch A/B tests — suggest enabling rate limits per-route as a safety net.
Marta Kline: Agreed. Also recommend alerting thresholds at 70% of reserved capacity during campaign windows.
Nina Park: Added to playbook. Will follow up with short demo next week.
Jonas Reed: Thanks all.
